# A draft invoice for customer C001, with one line.
#
# Read into a book once, and then again with its line giving a guid that is
# no guid, which the test writes in: the second read compares the invoice the
# book holds against the file before it pairs any line.
#
# What this fixture produces: customer C001, and INV-LINE, 100.00 CAD, not
# posted.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_line_guid_nothing_can_parse_is_refused_on_a_second_read.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-LINE"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
